purpose: Regression fixtures for document text-layer extraction and OCR routing.
expectedText: Don vi phai luu giu day du ho so va chung tu.
notes: DOCX is the deterministic text-layer regression fixture.
Image and image-only PDF must route to OCR.
Synthetic text PDF accepts either successful text extraction or safe OCR routing because the currently pinned legacy PDF parser may reject some valid xref/layout variants; it must never crash intake.
